game.name: Sniper : Ghost Warrior (Germany)
game.desc: Sniper: Ghost Warrior is a first-person shooter for Xbox 360. The democratic government of the small island Isla Trueno is overthrown by a despot. The player takes on the role of a sniper from a military faction that wants the old regime back. It's up to you to make a difference. The game is almost entirely based on sniping and therefore infiltration.
